description: A stranger can invoke an in-repo mechanical scorer as `python3 -m gak_conformance` without installing or importing Deponent as the harness.
user_value: The category is testable by someone who is not us.
verification: python3 -m gak_conformance --help exits 0
import gak_conformance succeeds with repo root on sys.path
gak_conformance module source does not import deponent

description: Score command accepts `--adapter module:Class` and emits a JSON receipt.
user_value: Kernel authors plug in their adapter without editing the harness.
verification: python3 -m gak_conformance score --adapter gak_conformance.fixtures.action_gate:PassingActionAdapter --out <tmp>/receipt.json
receipt.json exists and parses as JSON

description: A fixture adapter scores end-to-end with Deponent absent from the environment.
user_value: Clone → command → receipt works on a clean machine.
verification: Run score against fixture in a subprocess whose PYTHONPATH cannot import deponent
Exit 0 or 1 is from the harness, never ModuleNotFoundError: deponent

description: Receipt matches spec §5.1: kernel, profile, conformant, counts, all 13 v1 clauses with id/profile/status/detail, and no timestamp.
user_value: A consumer can re-derive the verdict from the receipt alone.
verification: Required keys present; timestamp absent
len(clauses)==13 for harness gak-conformance/v1
each clause has id, profile, status in {PASS,FAIL,NA}, detail

description: Digest algorithm §5.3 re-derives the published Deponent v1 digest de6b7089… from the published receipt.
user_value: Existing evidence remains checkable after the harness moves in-repo.
verification: gak_conformance.receipt.clauses_digest(published_receipt) == de6b7089f894e009a6d1a1dba8c9b32b26e38daf803b07b83ec0958ff64c5406
compact-separator encoding is not used

description: Fail-closed exits: 0 only when conformant; nonzero when not conformant, adapter load fails, or the run is incomplete.
user_value: CI can gate on the command without parsing prose.
verification: conformant fixture → exit 0
brick fixture → exit != 0
missing adapter → exit != 0

description: Public leave-behind contains no deponent/attest.py, 00Agent, cds-compliance, CMMC-RMF maps, ATO-in-a-Box, or per-control maps.
user_value: The standard can be published without private coupling.
verification: rg scan of product + release archive for forbidden tokens
release forbidden_scan == pass

description: README first score path is the in-repo fixture command, not `python3 -m deponent.badge verify`.
user_value: A stranger is not sent to install the author's kernel to try the standard.
verification: README contains `python3 -m gak_conformance`
Deponent verify is labeled optional reference-kernel scoring, not the first command

description: Default harness clause census is exactly the 13 frozen v1 IDs in spec §4.
user_value: The standard, not a kernel, defines the mark.
verification: set(clause ids) == 13 spec §4 ids
GAK-REDIRECT-DENIED and GAK-NEWLINE-CHAINED are absent from default census

description: An all-NA receipt is not conformant (§3.4).
user_value: A mis-declared adapter cannot earn the mark by doing nothing.
verification: Fixture with empty/unknown profile produces conformant=false
exit != 0

description: An adapter method that raises scores that clause FAIL, never PASS or NA (§3.3).
user_value: Harness fail-closed matches the category it scores.
verification: RaisingActionAdapter: at least one FAIL whose detail mentions the exception type
conformant is false

description: Out-of-profile clauses score NA, never FAIL.
user_value: Commit-gate kernels are not punished for lacking live-tool surfaces.
verification: Commit-gate fixture: every action-gate clause status == NA

description: Unclaimed optional capabilities score NA, never FAIL.
user_value: Authors can omit reconcile/attest honestly.
verification: Action fixture with supports=frozenset(): GAK-RECONCILE-UNDECLARED and GAK-ATTEST-HONEST are NA

description: A deny-everything action-gate is not conformant (GAK-ALLOW-INBOUNDS FAIL).
user_value: A brick is not a governor.
verification: BrickActionAdapter: GAK-ALLOW-INBOUNDS FAIL and conformant false

description: A deny-everything commit-gate is not conformant (GAK-COMMIT-ALLOW-CLEAN FAIL).
user_value: Same discrimination rule at commit scope.
verification: BrickCommitAdapter: GAK-COMMIT-ALLOW-CLEAN FAIL and conformant false

description: Two consecutive scores of an unchanged adapter produce identical clauses_digest.
user_value: The mark is a function of kernel behavior, not the wall clock.
verification: two subprocess scores; digests equal; receipts have no timestamp

description: Certification object matches spec §5.2 (schema_version, harness_version, mark, clauses_digest, id/status pairs).
user_value: A public claim has a digest-bearing pointer.
verification: score --certify or certify subcommand writes gak-certification/v1 JSON
mark is GAK-conformant iff conformant else not-conformant

description: `--out PATH` writes the receipt (or certification) as UTF-8 JSON.
user_value: Operators can keep the artifact next to their kernel.
verification: file exists; json.load succeeds; parent dirs created or fail-closed

description: `--help` and `selfcheck` work offline with no network and no Deponent.
user_value: First-run does not require credentials or sibling repos.
verification: help exit 0
selfcheck uses fixture only

description: `selfcheck` runs the fixture path and prints a one-line verdict plus digest.
user_value: An operator can confirm the harness itself runs.
verification: python3 -m gak_conformance selfcheck exits 0
stdout contains CONFORMANT or equivalent and a 64-hex digest

description: Invalid adapter spec (missing module, missing class, bad syntax) exits nonzero with a clear error and no receipt claiming conformant.
user_value: Load failures are not silent passes.
verification: --adapter not.a.module:X exits != 0
--adapter gak_conformance.fixtures.action_gate:NoSuch exits != 0

description: A missing required adapter method scores FAIL (AttributeError recorded), not a crash that looks like harness breakage without a receipt.
user_value: Partial adapters are scored, not excused.
verification: Incomplete adapter still emits a receipt with FAIL detail naming the missing method

description: counts.pass + counts.fail + counts.na equals the clause count for the harness version.
user_value: Receipts cannot hide a clause.
verification: property/unit test over fixtures and published receipts

description: CLI and README use bounded mark language: GAK-conformant means the clause set under the declared profile, not secure/audited/endorsed.
user_value: The leave-behind does not over-claim.
verification: rg for forbidden stretch words in README/CLI help
help mentions research prototype / clause-bounded claim

description: Consistency checker verifies spec ↔ in-repo clause table ↔ published evidence without importing deponent as the harness.
user_value: CI can run on a clone that has only this repo.
verification: python3 scripts/check_consistency.py exits 0 or 1 (never 3 for missing deponent)
source does not `from deponent.badge import` or `from deponent.conformance import`

description: When Deponent is importable, an optional adapter can be scored by the in-repo harness against the v1 13 clauses (not Deponent's 16).
user_value: Reference kernel remains scoreable without letting it own the harness.
verification: If deponent importable: score --adapter gak_conformance.adapters.deponent:DeponentKernelAdapter produces 13-clause receipt
If not importable: documented skip, not a harness crash

description: Clean install from the local release archive can run help + fixture score.
user_value: The shipped artifact, not the dirty worktree, is the product.
verification: create_release.py smoke commands pass in extracted zip

description: Release archive contains no secrets, .git, caches, personal paths, marathon pidfiles, or unrelated repos.
user_value: A public zip cannot leak the operator plane.
verification: safe_release_zip forbidden scan pass
no /Users/cj, no marathon.pid, no .git

description: pyproject.toml declares PEP 621 metadata, Apache-2.0, stdlib-only runtime dependencies.
user_value: Install is ordinary Python, not a private toolchain.
verification: pyproject.toml exists; [project] name/version/license
dependencies empty or stdlib-only

description: Adapter contract (attributes + methods of spec §6) is documented next to the score command so authors do not need Deponent source.
user_value: The integration surface is the spec plus one page, not a kernel repo.
verification: README or gak_conformance/adapter.py docstring lists name/profile/supports and methods
no instruction to read deponent/conformance.py

description: Optional `--harness gak-conformance/v1.1` adds only GAK-AUDIT-CONTENT-BLIND (14 clauses) and does not change v1 receipts.
user_value: v1 stays frozen; v1.1 remains capability-gated.
verification: default run still 13 clauses
v1.1 run 14 clauses including GAK-AUDIT-CONTENT-BLIND

description: Deponent-only probes GAK-REDIRECT-DENIED and GAK-NEWLINE-CHAINED are never emitted as GAK harness clauses.
user_value: Kernel-local hardening cannot silently become the category.
verification: default and v1.1 clause id sets exclude those two IDs

description: Commit-gate fixture on v1 yields 5 PASS / 8 NA / 0 FAIL and conformant true (3 commit + 2 universal).
user_value: Authors of commit-gates have a worked shape.
verification: counts match; GAK-COMMIT-* PASS; action-gate NA

description: Action-gate fixture claiming no optional capabilities yields NA on reconcile and attest and can still be conformant if remaining required clauses pass.
user_value: Optional capabilities are optional.
verification: supports empty; those two NA; no FAIL on required action-gate + universal chain clauses

description: `digest --receipt FILE` re-derives §5.3 from an existing receipt JSON.
user_value: Published evidence can be checked without re-running a kernel.
verification: digest of v1/evidence/deponent-conformance-receipt.json prints de6b7089… and exit 0

description: Consistency checker asserts frozen v1 digest string remains in spec.md and published certification.
user_value: v1 record cannot be silently rewritten.
verification: check_consistency fails if de6b7089… removed from spec
sabotage mutant test

description: Unknown profile or non-ASCII kernel name is rejected fail-closed (spec §5.3 ASCII kernel-name constraint).
user_value: Digest remains byte-reproducible across languages.
verification: adapter.profile='weird' → nonzero
adapter.name with non-ASCII → nonzero

description: Help text states that `--adapter` imports and executes Python; adapters must drive a real kernel; fixture adapters are harness tests, not kernel certifications.
user_value: Residual import risk is visible; fixture marks are not marketed as third-party verdicts.
verification: --help mentions import/execution and fixture vs kernel
